name: Yakovlev Yak-40
summary: Small three-engine regional jet built to fly from short, unpaved strips, with a straight wing and a rear airstair under the tail.

asset.author: Yak40devels: yaroslav.zavarzin, pilot40, a.a.babichev, FelisLeopard, Adrian (Maerchenprinz) and contributors

anim.note: Machina rig: the package draws this control but does not animate it

verify.note: The FlightGear model measures 20.83 m long and 6.68 m tall, with its trailing-link gear settled from its own compression animation, against the published 20.36 m and 6.5 m.

quality.reason: The FlightGear Yak-40 leaves its wings, engines and tail planes as plain white with no texture: 63% of the surface, 29% textured. Listed on request with that gap; the Machina livery paints the fuselage and fin.
